title: Counting oriented spanning trees in generalized join digraphs
summary: Let $G$ be a digraph with vertex set $\{1,2,...,n\}$ and $H_{1},H_{2},...,H_{n}$ be $n$ digraphs. The generalized join digraph $\overrightarrow{G}=G[H_{1},H_{2},...,H_{n}]$ is a digraph obtained from $G$ by replacing each vertex $i$ with $H_{i}$ and for any $u\in V(H_{i})$ and $v\in V(H_{j})$, $(u,v)\in E(\overrightarrow{G})$ if and only if $(i,j)\in E(G)$. In this paper we express the number of oriented spanning trees in $\overrightarrow{G}$ in terms of Laplacian eigenvalues of $H_{1},H_{2},...,H_{n}$ and oriented spanning trees of $G$.
